name: mod-firearms-gl-slug
about: The rifle's grenade launcher point-blank (rifle_gl_shell.unit, Launcher.as HWPFirearmsArm): a shell that hits an enemy before it has flown 40 px is a slug, half the blast's damage and a 0.5 s stun (stun_gl), with no blast; one that has armed explodes as before. gamelab/bots/gl_slug_check.py on target dummies at 30 and 100 px.
